notes.title: DEMO v2.0 is Available.
notes.notes:
🎮 Hello Everyone!
Demo v2.0 is now live! In this new version, the content from the previous demo has been expanded, and a few new features have been added. However, this demo still offers a prologue experience that lasts around 10-20 minutes.
All features will be available in the full version of the game. Development is still ongoing, and we are getting closer to completion.

The purpose of the demo is to learn the core mechanics and gather clues about the origin of the virus. This version represents only a small part of the game and offers a limited-time experience.

🚀 What's New in Demo v2.0?
• New missions:
o Single-player mode
o Story Transition Level (2 Levels)
o Weapon and behavior mechanics
o Facing zombie attacks
o 5 scenario missions

• Isometric city map
• Improved graphics and sound effects
• A smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience

The demo covers only 1% of the full game. Maps are limited, and all functions are locked. Simulation features are not included in v2.0.

Optimization efforts are ongoing to ensure a good experience even on low-end systems. However, this version is still in the testing phase, so you may encounter bugs and crashes. Please report any issues on our Discord channel or forums.

✅ Enjoy the game! Don’t forget to add the full game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Release Date & Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors!

The big day is approaching! We are officially announcing the release date for Colonies of the Remnant: [b]June 27, 2025[/b]. Our plan is to launch the game right after the June festival. Thank you for your patience—we’re making the most of this time to ensure the best possible experience!

🔥 [b]New Demo Incoming![/b]
We continue to bring you new content before launch. Next month, we’ll be releasing an updated demo so you can experience the latest developments in the game.

💍 [b]Marriage System for Strategic Advantages![/b]
Our game keeps evolving! One of the latest features we’ve added is the Marriage System. Your character can now marry a suitable partner—but this is more than just a personal choice. Marriage offers strategic opportunities, from securing peace between colonies to gaining food supplies and trade advantages. The full details are still being refined, but choosing the right partner will provide a major strategic edge!

🐔 [b]Chicken Farms, Pig Breeding, and More![/b]
We’re adding new mechanics to help your colony grow and become more sustainable. Chicken farming and pig breeding are now part of the game! You can catch a glimpse of the chicken farm in our latest trailer. Chickens and eggs will be invaluable resources, playing a crucial role in sustaining your colony’s food supply. Every opportunity counts in the fight for survival!

📅 [b]The Big Day is Coming![/b]
We’re getting closer to sharing everything we’ve built with you. Stay tuned for more updates, because on June 27, 2025, the struggle for survival truly begins!

These colony leaders have risen from the ashes, their authority forged through blood, cunning, and sheer survival instinct. Some offer hope, others demand submission, but all of them are dangerous in.

notes.title: Basketball Mechanics
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

Want to take a short break from the dark atmosphere of the zombie apocalypse? With the new Basketball Mechanic, you can now add a touch of fun to your survival journey! 🏀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036453/1713686df034c545757ec52e7e4b4a5d320a8b9c.png[/img]

With this exciting new feature, you can gather resources on the main map to build your own basketball court, boosting both your morale and your teammates' motivation. Each successful shot will uplift your mood and energize your survival efforts.

This relaxing and entertaining break is a perfect way to lighten the weight of the zombie world and continue stronger as a team. So, gather your resources, build the court, and level up your game!

Keep surviving, but don’t forget to have fun along the way!

Stay tuned for updates on new weapons and outfits we’ll be releasing soon!

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1 and Leaving Beta Test
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you know, we previously released a short demo for playtesting purposes. We have added various updates to this demo, but we have decided to remove version 1.1 from release on October 17, 2024.

Our reasons are as follows:

-As we mentioned earlier on our forums and Discord channel, the decision to release the demo was made at the last minute. Cutting a small piece from the whole is definitely not recommended, and it brought along various bugs.
-Although the concept remains the same, the isometric map features more functional mechanics, physics, and visuals. However, these elements did not reflect as we intended in the demo.
-The demo did not provide sufficient information about key functions such as simulation, base building, survival elements, and relationships with colonies, which are the focal points of our game.
-Performance issues, including frame rate drops on low-end systems, were experienced. 

As a result, version 1.1 served as a playtest for us as well, giving us the opportunity to observe the existing issues.

In the coming process, we will release a new demo featuring mechanics for the full version. In the upcoming weeks, we will share some gameplay trailers and various cinematics to better convey the concept.

Thank you!

And; 
[b]ONLY TRUST YOUR OWN PEOPLE. THERE ARE CREATURES IN THIS NEW WORLD MORE DANGEROUS THAN THE DEAD!
[/b]

notes.title: Thousands of Wishlists & New Release Date [Important Notification]
notes.notes:
💥First and foremost, we want to thank you a thousand times for the thousands of wishlists. The interest you've shown in our game has truly made our team very happy and boosted our motivation. [b]Colonies of the Remnant[/b] holds a special place in our hearts. We love the zombie world, and combining it with post-apocalyptic, action-simulation themes seems to have excited not only us but everyone else as well.

After much consideration, we regret to announce that we have decided to retract Colonies of the Remnant launch release date, previously set for November 15th. This was not an easy decision, especially since we understand the anticipation and excitement that many players have for the game. However, we believe that additional development time is needed.

We want our game to run smoothly and efficiently on lower-end systems as well. Additionally, we've taken note of the feedback you've provided via email, our discussion forums, and Discord. We have a ton of new features to add. We'll be announcing the features we've completed or are currently working on.

Since our last check-in, we’ve been working on tons of new features, from unit remodels to new environments and character refinements. 

Our goal is to make Colonies of the Remnant the best game it can be and provide a truly exceptional and rewarding experience for players. 

We sincerely apologize for this delay and genuinely appreciate your understanding. Your support and passion are vital to us, and we will continue to work intensively to deliver the ultimate zombie-post apocalyptic survival experience. We intend to keep you informed and engaged in the development process by regularly showcasing more [b]Colonies of the Remnant[/b] assets in the weeks ahead.

[b]Our new and final release date is June 27, 2025 [/b]💭

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE! [October 2024 Steam Next Fest Announcement]
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
It is with great pleasure we can announce the Colonies of the Remnant demo is now available to play throughout STEAM'S NEXT FEST!

The demo only contains a taste of what's to come; there are many more details we are still working on before they are ready for all to see. But for now, please enjoy playing the demo & be sure to let us know your thoughts -  your feedback is essential to helping us shape this game to be the best it can be.

This demo is a limited-time experience, offering 10-20 minutes of gameplay. Full access to all features will be available in the complete game. The development process is still ongoing.
The main objective of this demo is for the players to learn the basic mechanics of the game, begin collecting information to discover how the virus started. The Demo version will just be a limited part of the game, which is still under heavy development.

This is the first version available to the public. You can download it for free on Steam!
Don't forget to wishlist the full game. 

[b]WHAT DOES THE DEMO VERSION INCLUDE?[/b]

The demo provides a glimpse of our game style and basic gameplay. Demo covers only 1% of the full version. Playable for 10-20 minutes. Maps are closed or have limited features. Simulation features are not included in the content.

-Single Player Mode
-Transition Level to Story (2 Level)
-Weapon Mechanics
-Basic Behavioral Mechanics
-Confronting zombie attacks
-2 Scenario Missions

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER MODE & Co-op - In Planning
notes.notes:
Greetings to everyone.

Today we are happy to announce the multiplayer mode.

In addition to the Single-Player game mode, we have developed some ideas for Multiplayer.

Colonies of the Remnant will be playable in multiplayer mode.

However, we also want to add the co-op mode to the game. This will have a series of complex processes. We haven't decided how to proceed with the co-op mode yet. But for us, the most logical option is to make a slow and correct decision rather than a fast and wrong decision. So we won't rush into this. Co-op mode has entered our calendar. In order to improve the gaming experience, we must think carefully about this.

You will be able to test this feature in the game demo that we will publish in the future.

There is no other trailer for now. We plan to share more about the multiplayer mode with you throughout the development process.

Stay tuned.
